bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to children, youth, and families; appropriating money for grants for forensic interview training scholarships.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS; FORENSIC INTERVIEW TRAINING SCHOLARSHIPS.

$250,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for grants to provide training scholarships for recipients to attend nationally recognized forensic interview protocol training. Eligible grantees must award scholarships for recipients to attend basic forensic interview training, advanced forensic interview training, and specialized interview topics training. Scholarship recipients may include individuals in law enforcement, child protection, and prosecution; health professionals investigating, treating, and managing child maltreatment cases in Minnesota; advocates working with a multidisciplinary team; and forensic interviewers at children's advocacy centers.
additions: $250,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for grants to provide training scholarships for recipients to attend nationally recognized forensic interview protocol training. Eligible grantees must award scholarships for recipients to attend basic forensic interview training, advanced forensic interview training, and specialized interview topics training. Scholarship recipients may include individuals in law enforcement, child protection, and prosecution; health professionals investigating, treating, and managing child maltreatment cases in Minnesota; advocates working with a multidisciplinary team; and forensic interviewers at children's advocacy centers.

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to children, youth, and families; appropriating money for grants for forensic interview training scholarships.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS; FORENSIC INTERVIEW TRAINING SCHOLARSHIPS.

$250,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $250,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for grants to nationally recognized forensic interview protocol organizations to award scholarships for basic forensic interview training, advanced forensic interview training, and training on specialized interview topics. Scholarship recipients may include individuals in law enforcement, child protection, and prosecution; health professionals investigating, treating, and managing child maltreatment cases in Minnesota; and forensic interviewers at children's advocacy centers.

Scholarship recipients may include individuals in law enforcement, child protection, and prosecution; health professionals investigating, treating, and managing child maltreatment cases in Minnesota; and forensic interviewers at children's advocacy centers.
